candidate.name: Río Tinto drilling-study region
candidate.coordinateNote: Converted published deployment coordinate 37°43′30.99″N, 6°33′34.92″W; the DEM window is much larger than the drill site.
candidate.condition: Iron/sulfur-rich subsurface sampling and automated sample-to-instrument workflows
candidate.literatureEvidence: Published robotic drilling used mineralogical and biomarker analyses for ground truth. NASA explicitly distinguishes the biological analogue from a mechanical/textural analogue.
candidate.uses: Frame drilling, sample-transfer and contamination-control research questions.
candidate.limits: River, mining and biological processes require separate footprint/water/geochemical review. A high terrain index cannot establish the published biochemical analogy or rover traction.

site.name: Río Tinto drilling-study region
site.description: A newly retrieved 32 km Earth elevation window centered at 37.72528°, -6.55970°. Passed the coarse and detailed coastline screens; small water bodies and current field conditions remain unverified.
limitations: Coarse elevation cannot resolve individual rocks or robot-scale hazards; terrain resemblance does not establish material, thermal, biological or operational equivalence.
Land access, permits, environmental protection and field safety have not been assessed.

data.name: Río Tinto drilling-study region
data.orientation: Rows decrease latitude; columns increase continuous/unwrapped longitude.

source.title: Mapzen / Tilezen Terrarium mixed-source elevation tiles
source.datum: Source-dependent mixed DEM heights in metres; Web Mercator tile positioning (EPSG:3857). Consult original datasets for vertical datum and accuracy.
source.sampling: Direct RGB Terrarium decode without colour conversion; pixel-center-correct bilinear samples across tile seams into a 500 m grid.

landScreening.method: 5 × 5 samples against Natural Earth 1:110m land polygons; coarse coastline screen only, not a detailed inland-water classification.

coarse.method: 5 × 5 samples against Natural Earth 1:110m land polygons; coarse coastline screen only, not a detailed inland-water classification.

detailed.method: 65 × 65 point screen plus polygon-boundary intersections with the complete window; shared internal land-polygon edges ignored. Sample counts are not area fractions.

coverageAssessment.limitation: Natural Earth 1:10 million is generalized coastline mapping, not 10-metre resolution. Passing these checks does not verify all small water bodies, current shorelines, dry ground or field suitability.

source.caveat: Mixed elevation sources may include SRTM, USGS 3DEP/GMTED2010, Copernicus EU-DEM and NOAA bathymetry. Tile pixel spacing is not guaranteed source accuracy or effective resolution. Negative elevations are retained and are not used as an ocean classifier.
